# Add or subtract

<!-- STEP id="three" -->
Same direction: add. 10 N + 6 N = 16 N to the right.

Opposite directions: subtract. 10 N - 6 N = 4 N, towards the larger force. That is to the right when the 10 N force points right, and to the left when it points left.

<!-- STEP id="turn" -->
Forces can also act at an angle to each other. And equal and opposite forces on the two ends of a handlebar or a tap make it turn. You will learn about these in higher grades.
